name: SonarQube Quality Hub
description: A modern read-only SonarQube workspace with project switching, analysis history, issue filtering and global quality insights.
releaseNotes: Initial release: read-only PostgreSQL connection, project overview, issue explorer, analysis history, local issue snapshots and global project statistics. Fixed DBX protocol initialization compatibility for empty capabilities.
